verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Haa-meem
Wal-kitaabil-mubeen
Innaa ja'alnaahu qur'aanan arabiyyan la-allakum ta'qiloon
Wa innahu fee ummil-kitaabi ladaynaa la-aliyyun hakeem
Afanadribu ankumudh-dhikra safhan an kuntum qawman musrifeen
Wa kam arsalnaa min nabiyyin fil-awwaleen
Wa maa ya'teehim min nabiyyin illaa kaanoo bihi yastahzi'oon
Fa-ahlaknaa ashadda minhum batshan wa madaa mathalul-awwaleen
Wa la-in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda layaqoolunna khalaqahunnal-azeezul-aleem
Al-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-arda mahdan wa ja'ala lakum feehaa subulan la-allakum tahtadoon
Wal-ladhee nazzala minas-samaa'i maa'an biqadarin fa-ansharnaa bihi baldatan maytan kadhaalika tukhrajoon
Wal-ladhee khalaqal-azwaaja kullahaa wa ja'ala lakum minal-fulki wal-an'aam maa tarkaboon
Litastawoo alaa zuhoorihi thumma tadhkuroo ni'mata rabbikum idhas-tawaytum alayhi wa taqooloo subhaanal-ladhee sakhkhara lanaa haadhaa wa maa kunnaa lahu muqrineen
Wa innaa ilaa rabbinaa lamunqaliboon
Wa ja'aloo lahu min ibaadihi juz'an innal-insaana lakafoorun mubeen
Am ittakhadha mimmaa yakhluqu banaatin wa asfaakum bil-baneen
Wa idhaa bushshira ahaduhum bimaa daraba lir-Rahmaani mathalan zalla wajhuhu muswaddan wa huwa kazeem
Awaman yunashsha'u fil-hilyati wa huwa fil-khisaami ghayru mubeen
Wa ja'alul-malaa'ikatal-ladheena hum ibaadur-Rahmaani inaathan ashahidoo khalqahum satuktabu shahaadatuhum wa yus'aloon
Wa qaaloo law shaa'ar-Rahmaanu maa abadnaahum maa lahum bidhaalika min ilmin in hum illaa yakhrusoon
Am aataynaahum kitaaban min qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoon
Bal qaaloo innaa wajadnaa aabaa'anaa alaa ummatin wa innaa alaa aathaarihim muhtadoon
Wa kadhalika maa arsalnaa min qablika fee qaryatin min nadheerin illaa qaala mutrafoohaa innaa wajadnaa aabaa'anaa alaa ummatin wa innaa alaa aathaarihim muqtadoon
Qaala awalaw ji'tukum bi-ahdaa mimmaa wajadtum alayhi aabaa'akum qaaloo innaa bimaa ursiltum bihi kaafiroon
Fantaqamnaa minhum fanzur kayfa kaana aaqibatul-mukadhdhibeen
Wa idh qaala ibraaheemu li-abeehi wa qawmihi innanee baraa'un mimmaa ta'budoon
Illal-ladhee fataranee fa-innahu sayahdeen
Wa ja'alahaa kalimatan baaqiyatan fee aqibihi la-allahum yarji'oon
Bal matta'tu haa'ulaa'i wa aabaa'ahum hattaa jaa'ahumul-haqqu wa rasoolun mubeen
Wa lammaa jaa'ahumul-haqqu qaaloo haadhaa sihrun wa innaa bihi kaafiroon
Wa qaaloo lawlaa nuzzila haadhal-qur'aanu alaa rajulin minal-qaryatayni azeem

Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamnaa baynahum ma'eeshatahum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa rafa'naa ba'dahum fawqa ba'din darajaatin liyattakhidha ba'duhum ba'dan sukhriyyan wa rahmatu rabbika khayrun mimmaa yajma'oon
Wa lawlaa an yakoonan-naasu ummatan waahidatan laja'alnaa liman yakfuru bir-rahmani libuyootihim suqufan min faddatin wa ma'aarija alayhaa yazharoon
Wa libuyootihim abwaaban wa sururan alayhaa yattaki'oon
Wa zukhrufan wa in kullu dhaalika lammaa mataa'ul-hayaatid-dunyaa wal-aakhiratu inda rabbika lilmuttaqeen
Wa man ya'shu an dhikrir-Rahmaani nuqayyid lahu shaytaanan fahuwa lahu qareen
Wa innahum layasuddoonahum anis-sabeeli wa yahsaboona annahum muhtadoon
Hattaa idhaa jaa'anaa qaala yaa layta baynee wa baynaka bu'dal-mashriqayni fabi'sal-qareen
Wa lan yanfa'akumul-yawma idh zalamtum annakum fil-adhaabi mushtarikoon
Afa'anta tusmi'us-summa aw tahdil-umya wa man kaana fee dalaalin mubeen
Fa-immaa nadhhabanna bika fa-innaa minhum muntaqimoon
Aw nuriyannakal-ladhee wa-adnaahum fa-innaa alayhim muqtadiroon
Fastamsik billadhee oohiya ilayka innaka alaa siraatin mustaqeem
Wa innahu ladhikrun laka wa liqawmika wa sawfa tus'aloon
Was'al man arsalnaa min qablika min rusulinaa aja'alnaa min doonir-Rahmaani aalihatan yu'badoon
Wa laqad arsalnaa moosaa bi-aayaatinaa ilaa fir'awna wa mala'ihi faqaala innee rasoolu rabbil-aalameen
Falammaa jaa'ahum bi-aayaatinaa idhaa hum minhaa yadhakoon
Wa maa nureehim min aayatin illaa hiya akbaru min ukhtihaa wa akhadhnaahum bil-adhaabi la-allahum yarji'oon
Wa qaaloo yaa ayyuhas-saahiru ud'u lanaa rabbaka bimaa ahida indaka innanaa lamuhtadoon
Falammaa kashafnaa anhumul-adhaaba idhaa hum yankuthoon
Wa naadaa fir'awnu fee qawmihi qaala yaa qawmi alaysa lee mulku misra wa haadhihil-anhaaru tajree min tahtee afalaa tubsiroon
Am anaa khayrun min haadhal-ladhee huwa maheenun wa laa yakaadu yubeen
Falawlaa ulqiya alayhi aswiratun min dhahabin aw jaa'a ma'ahul-malaa'ikatu muqtarineen
Fastakhaffa qawmahu fa-ataa'oohu innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
Falammaa aasafoonaa intaqamnaa minhum fa-aghraqnaahum ajma'een
Faja'alnaahum salafan wa mathalan lil-aakhireen
Wa lammaa duriba ubnu maryama mathalan idhaa qawmuka minhu yasiddoon
Wa qaaloo a'aalihatunaa khayrun am huwa maa daraboohu laka illaa jadalan bal hum qawmun khasimoon
In huwa illaa abdun an'amnaa alayhi wa ja'alnaahu mathalan libanee israa'eel
Wa law nashaa'u laja'alnaa minkum malaa'ikatan fil-ardi yakhlufoon
Wa innahu la-ilmun lis-saa'ati falaa tamtarunna bihaa wattabi'oonee haadhaa siraatun mustaqeem
Wa laa yasuddannakumush-shaytaanu innahu lakum aduwwun mubeen
Wa lammaa jaa'a eesaa bil-bayyinaati qaala qad ji'tukum bil-hikmati wa li-abayyina lakum ba'dal-ladhee takhtalifoona feehi fattaqoo Allaaha wa atee'oon
Innallaaha huwa rabbee wa rabbukum fa'budoohu haadhaa siraatun mustaqeem
Fakhtalafal-ahzaabu min baynihim fawaylun lilladheena zalamoo min adhaabi yawmin aleem
Hal yanzuroona illas-saa'ata an ta'tiyahum baghtatan wa hum laa yash'uroon
Al-akhillaa'u yawma'idhin ba'duhum liba'din aduwwun illal-muttaqeen
Yaa ibaadi laa khawfun alaykumul-yawma wa laa antum tahzanoon
Al-ladheena aamanoo bi-aayaatinaa wa kaanoo muslimeen
Udkhulul-jannata antum wa azwaajukum tuhbaroon
Yutaafu alayhim bisihaafin min dhahabin wa akwaabin wa feehaa maa tashtaheehil-anfusu wa taladhdhul-a'yunu wa antum feehaa khaalidoon
Wa tilkal-jannatul-latee oorithtumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
Lakum feehaa faakihatun katheeratun minhaa ta'kuloon
Innal-mujrimeena fee adhaabi jahannama khaalidoon
Laa yufattaru anhum wa hum feehi mublisoon
Wa maa zalamnaahum wa laakin kaanoo humuz-zaalimeen
Wa naadaw yaa maaliku liyaqdi alaynaa rabbuka qaala innakum maakithoon
Laqad ji'naakum bil-haqqi wa laakinna aktharakum lilhaqqi kaarihoon
Am abramoo amran fa-innaa mubrimoon
Am yahsaboona annaa laa nasma'u sirrahum wa najwaahum balaa wa rusulunaa ladayhim yaktuboon
Qul in kaana lir-Rahmaani waladun fa-anaa awwalul-aabideen
Subhaana rabbis-samaawaati wal-ardi rabbil-arshi ammaa yasifoon
Fadharhum yakhoodoo wa yal-aboo hattaa yulaaqoo yawmahumul-ladhee yoo'adoon
Wa huwal-ladhee fis-samaa'i ilaahun wa fil-ardi ilaahun wa huwal-hakeemul-aleem
Wa tabaarakal-ladhee lahu mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa baynahumaa wa indahu ilmus-saa'ati wa ilayhi turja'oon
Wa laa yamlikul-ladheena yad'oona min doonihish-shafaa'ata illaa man shahida bil-haqqi wa hum ya'lamoon
Wa la-in sa'altahum man khalaqahum layaqoolunna Allaahu fa-annaa yu'ufakoon
Wa qeelihi yaa rabbi inna haa'ulaa'i qawmun laa yu'minoon
Fasfah anhum wa qul salaamun fasawfa ya'lamoon
